blocks.text: BUENOS AIRES, Argentina — Pope Leo XIV led a massive Mass in Argentina on Monday, attended by 2.5 million pilgrims, and urged the protection of society’s most vulnerable as he met with people with disabilities and victims of clerical abuse. The Mass in Buenos Aires drew the largest crowd of Leo’s papacy to date, as the faithful traveled from far and wide to see the 71-year-old pontiff less than a month after he underwent lung cancer surgery. Cheering crowds waving flags packed a stretch of Avenida del Libertador several kilometers long, with excitement reaching a fever pitch when giant screens relayed images […]...
